<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(label):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    bar=[n['pixels'] for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>50]
    ng=sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='norn' or (n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==9))

for (r,c) in [(49,29),(54,24),(54,34),(59,29)]:

    r2=dict(res)
    r2['gc']=res.get('game_over'); r2['done']=res.get('done')
    snap(f"after{(r,c)}", )
    print({'k':v for k,v in r2.items() if v not in (None,False,0,'')})
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over'): break
</parameter>
</function>
